mechanism_narrative: An increase in PAYEMS (non-farm employment) signals a strong labor market, which is likely to drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days as consumer spending and business activity increase.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases by more than 0.5% month-over-month, but the S&P 500 does not show positive 20-day returns in at least 60% of the cases over the next year.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.5% indicates a strong labor market, leading to increased consumer confidence and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE falls below 4.5% but the S&P 500 shows negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of the cases over the next year.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and stable CPI (CPIAUCSL) suggests accommodative monetary policy without inflationary pressures, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS is below 1% and CPIAUCSL growth is below 2% year-over-year, but the S&P 500 does not show positive 60-day returns in at least 70% of the cases over the next year.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4.5% indicates tighter monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days as borrowing costs increase and corporate earnings are pressured.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5% but the S&P 500 shows positive 20-day returns in more than 30% of the cases over the next year.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real final sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days as companies experience increased revenues and profits.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases by more than 2% quarter-over-quarter, but the S&P 500 does not show positive 60-day returns in at least 65% of the cases over the next year.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 105 indicates strong economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days as production and economic growth accelerate.
failure_condition: If INDPRO exceeds 105 but the S&P 500 shows negative 20-day returns in more than 35% of the cases over the next year.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of increasing GDP (GDPC1) and low unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a strong economy, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days as both demand and labor market conditions are favorable.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 increases by more than 2% annually and UNRATE is below 5%, but the S&P 500 does not show positive 60-day returns in at least 70% of the cases over the next year.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of housing starts (HOUST) indicates increased construction activity, which may signal late-cycle economic expansion, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days as the economy approaches a potential slowdown.
failure_condition: If HOUST exceeds 1.1 million but the S&P 500 shows positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of the cases over the next year.
